مُسَدَّمٌ : see سَدِمٌ, in the former half of the paragraph. ―
-b2- Also A camel left to pasture by itself (K, TA) around the dwelling. (TA.) ―
-b3- And A [camel of generous race, such as is termed] فَنِيق having a muzzle put upon his mouth. (S.) ―
-b4- And A camel having galls, or sores, upon his back, and therefore exempted from the saddle until his galls, or sores, have become healed. (K.) ＝
-A2- See also سَدِمٌ, last sentence, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
